q1_issues.issue: The sealed complement drops the entire means alternation "wirelessly or from a PC via USB connection" — no Or, no manner, no source, no record of it at all.

The compound-action decomposition atoms (Inheritance install_application install, Patient install_application application, and the install_software pair) are sealed inside the Theme term instead of standing at top level as definitional facts, unlike the "Contractors must show a badge at entry" example which emits them outside the ConditionalProperty.
"their handset" loses its possessive link to the customers — the condition slot holds the bare kind handset with nothing tying it to the subject.

q2_gaps: Manner adverbs, source/means PPs, and a disjunction over them modifying a kind-level reified capability ((can <action>)) — the property form mints no event witness to carry obliques, and ConditionalProperty offers only a single condition slot.
A possessive bound to the kind subject of a kind-level norm ("customers can install ... on THEIR handset") — a bare kind in the condition slot has no way to carry the possessor.
notes: The say-attitude frame (Experiencer holder + sealed Theme, no status atom on the simple present), the capability-generic property form, and the verb_object compound shape are all correctly chosen; the failure is entirely in what the complement drops and where the decomposition atoms sit.
